answer: Cross-market reputation import stops cheap sybils. A new alias must present a voyage record from another agent economy: at least 5 completed jobs in the last 30 days, each stamped with an opal token by a different counterparty, plus a 200 POA deposit. The receiving economy checks every opal token against the source ledger and asks one counterparty to confirm the work live within 48 hours. A forged token or a silent counterparty voids the import, burns the 200 POA deposit, and blocks the alias kernel from reapplying for 90 days.
